lead.headline: Purdy won the duel. Big Stric’s comeback dies at 140.4.
lead.dek: One starter each, one game left. Brock Purdy put up 22.2 for Maye I touch your TDs?, Justin Jefferson managed 13.7 for Big Stric Energy, and the champ walks off a 163.52 to 140.4 winner. The tight end slot still reads 0.0.
lead.pull: Jefferson needed to beat Purdy by a mile. He lost to him by 8.5.
body: It’s over, and it’s over before Monday. Big Stric Energy went into Sunday night with one bullet left, Justin Jefferson, against the champ’s one bullet, Brock Purdy. Jefferson was projected for 18.02 and came in at 13.7. Purdy was projected for 17.66 and came in at 22.2. Final: Maye I touch your TDs? 163.52, Big Stric Energy 140.4. A 23.12-point loss with nobody left on either side.

Give the afternoon its due. Ashton Jeanty went for 27.9 on a 12.66 projection, Geno Smith closed at 19.44 and Tyler Bass kicked in 17.0. That is how a franchise that looked finished at lunch dragged this into a Sunday-night coin flip. Then the coin landed on Purdy.

Now the part this desk isn’t letting go of. Big Stric started Dalton Kincaid at tight end, Kincaid was Out with the thumb, and the slot went in the books at 0.0 for a team that played its whole game without him. That’s a busted lineup, start to finish. The bench had no tight end to save it, with Tucker Kraft on bye, and Dawson Knox was sitting on the wire. The champ’s tight end, Michael Mayer, gave it 1.4. Big Stric lost the tight end battle to 1.4.

Did the zero cost the game? Probably not on its own. The margin was 23.12, and the bench had Saquon Barkley’s 13.5 parked behind Braelon Allen’s 9.4, which wouldn’t have closed it either. Josh Allen’s 14.16 against a 24.67 projection hurt just as much. But in a two-team race between 2-8 clubs, a franchise can’t spot anybody a free position.

What it means: the champ pulls even with Santa Clara’s Finest in the loss column, and Santa Clara’s Finest, which entered the week holding the last playoff spot at 57.1%, is getting buried by Poochinski. Big Stric Energy entered at 17.7% and leaves Sunday night with the worst-case result. The champ entered at 25.2% and is the one with a pulse now.

quick_hits.headline: Every matchup left comes down to one Monday game
quick_hits.body: Every R.A.T.S. player still to play is in the same Monday game. deeboliciouskins has three left (Jayden Daniels, Ja’Marr Chase, Drew Stevens); AB81 has one (the Cincinnati Bengals D/ST); Cherry Blossom has Tee Higgins; Bad things man bad things has Evan McPherson; Santa Clara’s Finest has Joe Burrow and Stefon Diggs; Poochinski has Chase Brown. None of the trailing teams has a realistic path.

quick_hits.headline: Bad things needs McPherson to outscore Higgins by 25
quick_hits.body: Cherry Blossom leads Bad things man bad things 169.1 to 144.56 after Christian McCaffrey added 14.2 Sunday night and Kirk Cousins finished at 8.4. Bad things’ last man is kicker Evan McPherson (7.59 projected); Cherry Blossom still has Tee Higgins (18.72). Live projection 187.82 to 152.15, Cherry Blossom 99.9%. The morning call to start Jonah Coleman, who went for 34.9, is still the move of the day.

quick_hits.headline: Poochinski’s 12:51 PM defense scored 16.0
quick_hits.body: Poochinski grabbed the San Francisco 49ers D/ST at 12:51 PM to cover a bye, on a 7.56 projection. It put up 16.0 on Sunday night. Poochinski now leads Santa Clara’s Finest 191.04 to 78.86, with Chase Brown still to play, and projects 205.96 to 118.25. Dak Prescott’s 35.9 and CeeDee Lamb’s 30.2 did the rest.

quick_hits.headline: AB81’s best points are on the bench
quick_hits.body: AB81 trails deeboliciouskins 108.06 to 75.34 with only the Bengals D/ST left. Mike Evans (22.9) and George Kittle (18.4) finished their day on AB81’s bench while four starting slots sat on byes. deeboliciouskins projects 158.35 to 81.86 and is 100%, and DJ Moore’s 23.1 on its bench is the kind of problem a winner gets to have.

quick_hits.headline: The champ climbs, Big Stric slides
quick_hits.body: Santa Clara’s Finest held the last playoff spot at 57.1% coming in and loses this week. The champ, at 25.2% coming in, wins and pulls level with it in the loss column. Big Stric Energy, at 17.7%, takes the loss. Tuesday’s numbers will tell the rest.

w11-m1.headline: Final: the champ, 163.52 to 140.4
w11-m1.blurb: Brock Purdy’s 22.2 beat Justin Jefferson’s 13.7 in the last-man duel. Big Stric Energy’s 0.0 at tight end goes in the books with the loss.

w11-m2.headline: deeboliciouskins waits on Monday for the formality
w11-m2.blurb: Up 108.06 to 75.34 with Jayden Daniels, Ja’Marr Chase and Drew Stevens still to play. AB81 has the Bengals D/ST (6.52 projected). Live projection 158.35 to 81.86.

w11-m3.headline: Cherry Blossom, one receiver from done
w11-m3.blurb: Leads 169.1 to 144.56. Tee Higgins left for Cherry Blossom, Evan McPherson for Bad things. 99.9% Cherry Blossom.

w11-m4.headline: Poochinski, 191.04 and counting
w11-m4.blurb: Leads Santa Clara’s Finest 191.04 to 78.86 with Chase Brown left. Burrow and Diggs can pad the stat sheet on Monday, nothing more.

w11-r8-s7.headline: AB81’s flex is still on a bye
w11-r8-s7.blurb: Rhamondre Stevenson holds the flex on a bye, and George Kittle’s 18.4 finished on the bench. With Sunday done, the only way to fill the slot now is a Monday player off the wire.

w11-r4-s7.headline: The Coleman call: 34.9
w11-r4-s7.blurb: Cherry Blossom sat Brock Bowers, who ended up Out, and started Jonah Coleman. 34.9 on a 17.46 projection, and the matchup flipped.

w11-r2-s10.headline: 49ers D/ST: 16.0
w11-r2-s10.blurb: Poochinski’s bye fill came in at 16.0 on Sunday night, more than double its 7.56 projection.

w11-r6-s9.headline: Drew Stevens kicks Monday
w11-r6-s9.blurb: deeboliciouskins swapped Jason Myers for Drew Stevens (6.91 projected). His day is still to come, and the game doesn’t need him.

trending_notes.9482: Michael Mayer, the most-added player in football, gave the champ 1.4 at tight end. That still beat Big Stric’s 0.0, and the champ won.
trending_notes.10236: Dalton Kincaid is one of the most-dropped players in football after a week in which he started for Big Stric Energy and scored 0.0.
trending_notes.5906: Dawson Knox is still on the R.A.T.S. wire. Any team short at tight end should look here.
trending_notes.6083: Matt Gay is one of the most-dropped players in football. He kicked 6.0 for the champ in a win.

2026-11-22-m1.blurb: Poochinski cut Aaron Rodgers (16.61 projected) for Kaelon Black at 9:23 AM. Black gave it 2.5 off the bench. In a two-quarterback league, a spare quarterback is worth more than a spare back.

2026-11-22-m2.blurb: deeboliciouskins dropped Kyler Murray, who was Out, for kicker Drew Stevens (6.91) at 9:42 AM. Filled the last hole. Stevens kicks Monday.

2026-11-22-m3.blurb: Poochinski added the San Francisco 49ers D/ST for Tyler Higbee at 12:51 PM to cover a bye. Projected 7.56, scored 16.0. The pickup of the day.
